summary.text: Claire Proctor is the Greens candidate for Bentleigh at the 2026 Victorian state election, on the VEC's list of nominations, and the ABC's guide also lists her. The Victorian Greens' online candidate list still named a different person, Karli McRostie, for Bentleigh as at 9 Nov 2026, and neither the party nor the ABC had published a biography of Claire Proctor.

sources.title: Candidates for Bentleigh District, Victorian Electoral Commission
Bentleigh, 2026 Victorian election guide, ABC News

summary.text: Herbert (Herb) Lonsing is One Nation's candidate for Bentleigh at the 2026 Victorian election. He joined Victoria Police as a 17-year-old cadet and spent more than 40 years in the force, in later years holding a management post at a suburban police station. His party says he was born and grew up in Bentleigh, where he and his wife raised three children.

prior_roles.role: Police officer, later in management at a local police station
prior_roles.note: Both sources describe his police career in the past tense; neither gives an end year.

priorities.text: Community safety, with more resources and support for emergency services
Cutting government waste and debt
Support for small business
Easing the cost of living, including energy and utility bills

sources.title: Bentleigh: 2026 Victorian election guide, ABC News

summary.text: Karli McRostie is the Greens candidate for Bentleigh at the 2026 Victorian election. She works for the Essential Services Commission in a stakeholder support role, has earlier worked in office administration and project coordination, and says she has lived in Bentleigh for over three decades and raised two children there.

occupation.text: Stakeholder support officer, Essential Services Commission

priorities.text: I want to be a positive voice for our community
Making housing more affordable in Bentleigh
Easing cost-of-living pressure on local households
Action on climate change

sources.title: Bentleigh: 2026 Victorian election guide, ABC News
Karli McRostie, Candidate for Bentleigh, Australian Greens

summary.text: Liam Kruger is the Victorian Socialists candidate for Bentleigh at the 2026 Victorian election. A lifelong Highett resident and Monash University graduate, he works in food service and is a union member. He was second on the party's Southern Metropolitan upper-house ticket at the 2022 state election.

previous_candidacies.note: Second on the Victorian Socialists ticket, which won 0.54% of the vote; no Victorian Socialists candidate was elected in the region.

priorities.text: everyone should have the chance to live a decent life
Tackling the housing shortage
Relief from the cost-of-living crisis

summary.text: Nick Staikos has held Bentleigh for Labor since 2014. He became a minister in December 2024 and since August 2026 has held the housing, building and precincts portfolio along with homelessness and seniors. He is recontesting Bentleigh in 2026.

summary.text: Tony Vainoras is the Australian Citizens Party candidate for Bentleigh at the 2026 Victorian election. Now retired, he worked as an engineer, ran a logistics company as a director and says he has been a party member for 17 years. He contested Hotham for the Citizens Party at the 2025 federal election.

previous_candidacies.note: Stood for the Australian Citizens Party, which took 2.5% of the first-preference vote in Hotham.

priorities.text: There is no excuse for homelessness and poverty in our country
Government that serves the common good rather than corporate interests
Has campaigned on men's legal and health issues

summary.text: Tynan Putt is the Liberal candidate for Bentleigh at the 2026 Victorian election. A former Victoria Police officer, he has spent more than 15 years in the private sector, including in commercial property leasing. He is married with three children, and his party says his family has been based in Bentleigh for over 70 years.

prior_roles.role: Volunteer basketball coach and football umpire

priorities.text: Bringing down living costs
Cutting crime
More help for small businesses
Better local roads
